_comment: Institutional research feeds polled weekly by the trackedInstitutions adapter. Each entry declares a feedType: 'rss', 'atom', or 'sitemap'. Failing institutions are skipped with a warning (not fatal). Sitemap mode is used when an institution has abandoned RSS but exposes a sitemap.xml — the adapter filters by lastmod date + URL path substring and fetches metadata per candidate page.
_history: 2026-06-30: initial scaffold. Discovered that many institutions abandoned RSS (Yale BL, Stanford DEL, Brookings, IMF Blog all return 200 but with empty/redirect bodies). Pivoted to sitemap-based polling for those, RSS for ones that still publish proper feeds (Hamilton Project verified working).

institutions.notes: Brookings-affiliated; publishes Acemoglu/Autor/Johnson Pro-Worker AI and other key labor-AI papers. RSS verified working 2026-06-30.

Canaries, AI Economic Indicators, Brynjolfsson group. Small sitemap (~1KB), may be an index — adapter resolves nested sitemaps automatically.
RSS /feed/ redirects to homepage. Sitemap polling for /articles/ paths picks up Kinder, Muro, and related Brookings labor research.
Economic Index reports (Primitives Jan, Learning Curves Mar, Cadences Jun 2026) + labor research. No public RSS. Anthropic has commercial interest — apply Tier 2.
